name: MELTDOWN
about: The C example MELTDOWN rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper: captive ball hits (15, then 30, then 45) light a 3-ball multiball where the core heats by itself and with every jackpot (x1 to x5) and the shields cool it; three stages with their own jackpot shots and music (BURNING GODZILLA's four jackpot shots and the moving heart that pays double, DESTOROYAH's spiral ray at one ramp then the other, JUNIOR at the Big loop and the Mecha lane), the line naming the shots and moving with them; each meltdown's super at the Building worth the jackpots paid x2, x3, x4 and taking it a stage further.
lost: No randomness in blocks: the HEART starts at the Left ramp and moves in turn (Left ramp, Right ramp, Building, Big loop) every 10 s and when hit, where the C picked another shot at random every 8 s (PAD-658: a moving target stays 10 s at least).

The HUD's line names the shots (RAMPS, BIG LOOP, BUILDING: 2X LEFT RAMP, moving with the heart), where the C said SHOOT RED SHOTS  -  THE HEART PAYS DOUBLE, and from CRITICAL SHIELDS COOL THE CORE  -  OR RIDE THE HEAT (the HOT and CRITICAL notes say the shields cool it, where the C's said JACKPOTS ARE WORTH MORE); the heart chases white, where the C blinked it faster in the heat's colour. Every note stays 3 s at least (the C's level notes 1.8 s, cadmium 1.5 s, the add-a-ball 2 s), a jackpot's naming the next shot (2X AT THE RIGHT RAMP); the captive ball's note says GODZILLA TARGET, where the C's said CAPTIVE BALL.
A shield cools the core only from 40%, while it is lit (what is lit counts, and only that), where the C's cooled it at any heat.
The core is looked at once a second (an Every second script), so it rises a whole 1% or 2% each second and the MELTDOWN blink quickens on the second, where the C stepped them every tick.

No timer badge: the MELTDOWN window is a timer the line counts (SUPER JACKPOT AT THE BUILDING: 17), where the C counted it on the MELTDOWN badge (a blocks badge counts only the mode's own clock, and this mode has none).

The HUD shows the core as a number (25), not 25%; the third counter has no SUPER value under it; the CORE gauge is one colour (the C's ran yellow to white-hot); the lines lost their double spaces to fit the 40 letters a blocks HUD line holds.

The ending's line under MELTDOWN TOTAL puts the jackpots last (1 MELTDOWN SURVIVED  -  JACKPOTS 6) where the C said 6 JACKPOTS  -  1 MELTDOWN SURVIVED, says JACKPOTS for one too, and past 3 meltdowns says only the jackpots.
The ending stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.
The ready light is the runtime's lit mode (held ball after ball), where the C pulsed MAGNA GRAB only while nothing else owned the playfield.
One ball left is checked once a second after 18 s (two looks in a row), the C's 2 s after the 15 s ball save and 3 s grace; and the C noted whether a second ball was ever served.
On Godzilla Pro 1.16 the two shields (left, right) cool the core and stay where they are (the Pro's do not turn); the C on a Pro cooled with the same two.
